field.prompt: Extract all nucleosomes and linking DNA to true alpha; preserve source material/lighting/scale, clear an organic central passage, no fluid backdrop or baked blur.

field-fill.prompt: Extract the exact full nucleosome/DNA field to true alpha; preserve source positions, colours and detail, remove all fluid background.

hero.prompt: Extract four nucleosomes and diagonal DNA only to true alpha, retain exact geometry, position and lighting.

dna.prompt: Remove fluid only, preserve molecular surface, colours, positions and lighting; true transparent holes.

assembly: Normalize to1254 square. Combine the two alpha field extractions into one populated middle plane. Static source-edge alpha taper on the wide field/purple cutouts prevents clipped square contours. Selected four-bead chain and closer DNA retain natural alpha. Nuclear background is the exact original registered nucleus crop, not a new fluid texture. Recompose every parent from the same world scene.
rendering: 2.5D optical layers, inherited illustrative physical scales; app-controlled relative zoom and blur only after parent replacement. No moving camera centre.
